my_shift_guide.title: How to use the Shifts page
my_shift_guide.description: On this page you can check the confirmed shifts assigned to you and submit swap requests.

view_shifts.title: Check your confirmed shifts
view_shifts.body: Shows the confirmed shifts assigned to the logged-in user in a monthly calendar or a weekly list. Dates without shifts are left blank.

steps.step2: The page automatically loads your confirmed shifts and shows them in the calendar or list
steps.step3: If there are no shifts, "No shifts" is displayed

switch_view.title: Switch the view
switch_view.body: You can switch between two views: a monthly calendar (good for the big picture) and a weekly list (good for details). Use the arrow buttons to move to the previous or next month or week.

steps.step1: Use the "Month view" and "Week view" buttons at the top of the screen to change the display format
steps.step2: Use the ◀ ▶ buttons to move to the previous or next month (or week)
steps.step3: Use the "Today" button to return to the month or week that contains today

filter_team.title: Filter by team
filter_team.body: If you belong to multiple teams, you can show only the shifts of a specific team. Select the "All" button to show the shifts of all teams.

steps.step1: Tap "All" or a team name button in the "Team:" field at the top of the screen
steps.step2: Only the shifts of the selected team are shown
steps.step3: Tap "All" again to clear the filter

view_detail.title: Check shift details
view_detail.body: Tap a specific date to see details of that shift, such as the team name, position, time, and schedule name.

steps.step1: [Month view] Tap a date cell to open the detail panel on the right side of the screen
steps.step2: [Week view] Tap the header of a date card to expand the card and show the list of shifts
steps.step3: In the month view, tap the same date again to close the detail panel

swap_request.title: Submit a swap request
swap_request.body: If you want to swap a confirmed shift with another member, you can send a request in one of three ways. After sending, the shift list is updated automatically.

steps.step1: Click the "Create swap request" button in the shift details
steps.step2: Choose how to send it: "Specify members" (select one or more) / "By shift period" (everyone working the day or night shift on the same day) / "Open to everyone" (anyone can volunteer)

swap_request.note: The list of confirmed shifts is updated automatically after submission. The button is disabled while sending, so please wait until it finishes.

shift_guide.title: How to use Shift Management
shift_guide.description: In Shift Management you can create and publish your team's shift schedules, and collect and adjust members' preferences.

overview.title: Check the list of shift schedules
overview.body: This page manages the list of your team's shift schedules. Status badges show progress at a glance.

steps.step1: Filter by status (Draft, Collecting, Adjusting, Published, etc.)
steps.step2: Check how many preferences members have submitted using the submission-rate bar on each card
steps.step3: Click a card to go to its detail page

create.title: Create a new shift schedule
create.body: Team administrators can create a new shift schedule. Get started by setting a title and a period.

steps.step1: Click the "Create" button at the top right
steps.step2: Enter the title, start date, and end date (required)
steps.step3: Enter the preference deadline and a memo as needed
steps.step4: Confirm with the "Create" button (it is created with the status Draft)

status.title: Advance the status to finalize shifts
status.body: Shifts are managed through five statuses. Check the current phase in the stepper on the detail page and advance in order.

steps.step1: "Draft": the preparation stage where you set up slots and constraints
steps.step2: "Collecting": ask members to submit their shift preferences
steps.step3: "Adjusting": adjust and build the shifts based on the preferences
steps.step4: "Published": publish the confirmed shifts to members

requests.title: Collect and review members' shift preferences
requests.body: Once the status is "Collecting", members can submit their preferences. In the "Preferences" tab on the detail page you can see everyone's status in a matrix.

steps.step1: Click the "Preferences" tab on the detail page
steps.step2: Check the submission rate and the number of members who have not submitted on the summary cards
steps.step3: Check each member's preference level for each date in the matrix table
steps.step4: Shown in five levels: "Wants to work / No preference / Can work if needed / Prefers off / Must be off"

slots.title: Set up slots and work constraints
slots.body: Register the time slots of the shift and set work constraints for the team and for individual members.

steps.step1: In the "Edit" tab, create slots (date, start to end time, position, required headcount)
steps.step2: You can also register multiple slots at once with the "Bulk create" button by date range and weekdays
steps.step3: In the "Constraints" tab, set the team's default work constraints (maximum monthly hours, consecutive working days, etc.)
steps.step4: For specific members, you can override constraints individually with "Per-member exceptions"
